title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Bourbon & Beyond, Louisville | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bourbon & Beyond whiskey and music festival, held at the Highland Festival Grounds at the Kentucky Exposition Center in Louisville, Kentucky, USA, on 13 September 2025.

It was the 14th show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s 2025 tour, and a slightly truncated version of the band’s normal set.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

Concert setlist

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
